HsapDv:0000000.definition: A spatiotemporal region encompassing some part of the life cycle of an organism.
HsapDv:0000000.label: life cycle stage

HsapDv:0000001.definition: Temporal interval that defines human life from the prenatal stage until late adulthood.
HsapDv:0000001.label: life cycle

HsapDv:0000002.definition: Prenatal stage that starts with fertilization and ends with a fully formed embryo, before undergoing last development during the fetal stage.
HsapDv:0000002.label: embryonic stage

HsapDv:0000003.definition: Embryonic stage defined by a fertilized oocyte and presence of pronuclei.
HsapDv:0000003.label: Carnegie stage 01

HsapDv:0000004.definition: Early stage of Carnegie stage 02 consisting of division of cells in the early embryo.
HsapDv:0000004.label: cleavage stage

HsapDv:0000005.definition: Embryonic stage during which cell division occurs with reduction in cytoplasmic volume, and formation of inner and outer cell mass.
HsapDv:0000005.label: Carnegie stage 02

HsapDv:0000006.definition: Embryonic stage that is an early stage of embryonic development in animals and is produced by cleavage of a fertilized ovum, with formation of a central fluid-filled cavity called the blastocoel.
HsapDv:0000006.label: blastula stage

HsapDv:0000007.definition: Blastula stage with the loss of the zona pellucida and the definition of a free blastocyst.
HsapDv:0000007.label: Carnegie stage 03

HsapDv:0000008.definition: Blastula stage during which the blastocyst becomes attached.
HsapDv:0000008.label: Carnegie stage 04

HsapDv:0000009.definition: Blastula stage during which implantation occurs.
HsapDv:0000009.label: Carnegie stage 05

HsapDv:0000010.definition: Embryonic stage defined by a complex and coordinated series of cellular movements that occurs at the end of cleavage.
HsapDv:0000010.label: gastrula stage

HsapDv:0000011.definition: Gastrula stage during which the extraembryonic mesoderm and primitive streak appear.
HsapDv:0000011.label: Carnegie stage 06

HsapDv:0000012.definition: Embryonic stage defined by the formation of a tube from the flat layer of ectodermal cells known as the neural plate.
HsapDv:0000012.label: neurula stage

HsapDv:0000013.definition: Neurula stage during which the notochordal process appears, and gastrulation is continuing.
HsapDv:0000013.label: Carnegie stage 07

HsapDv:0000014.definition: Neurula stage during which the primitive pit and the notochordal canal appear.
HsapDv:0000014.label: Carnegie stage 08

HsapDv:0000015.definition: Embryonic stage at which the ectoderm, endoderm, and mesoderm develop into the internal organs of the organism.
HsapDv:0000015.label: organogenesis stage

HsapDv:0000016.definition: Organogenesis stage during which somites 1-3 appear, and neural folds, cardiac primordium, and head fold are present.
HsapDv:0000016.label: Carnegie stage 09

HsapDv:0000017.definition: Organogenesis stage during which somites 4-12 appear, and the neural fold fuses.
HsapDv:0000017.label: Carnegie stage 10

HsapDv:0000018.definition: Organogenesis stage during which somites 13-20 appear, and the rostral neuropore closes.
HsapDv:0000018.label: Carnegie stage 11

HsapDv:0000019.definition: Organogenesis stage during which somites 21-29 appear, and the caudal neuropore closes.
HsapDv:0000019.label: Carnegie stage 12

HsapDv:0000020.definition: Organogenesis developmental stage during which somite 30 appears, and leg buds, lens placode, pharyngeal arches are present.
HsapDv:0000020.label: Carnegie stage 13

HsapDv:0000021.definition: Organogenesis stage during which lens pit and optic cup appear.
HsapDv:0000021.label: Carnegie stage 14

HsapDv:0000022.definition: Organogenesis stage during which lens vesicle, nasal pit, and hand plate appear.
HsapDv:0000022.label: Carnegie stage 15

HsapDv:0000023.definition: Organogenesis stage during which nasal pits moved ventrally, and features are auricular hillocks, and foot plate.
HsapDv:0000023.label: Carnegie stage 16

HsapDv:0000024.definition: Organogenesis stage during which finger rays become visible.
HsapDv:0000024.label: Carnegie stage 17

HsapDv:0000025.definition: Organogenesis stage during which ossification commences.
HsapDv:0000025.label: Carnegie stage 18

HsapDv:0000026.definition: Organogenesis stage during which the straightening of the trunk starts.
HsapDv:0000026.label: Carnegie stage 19

HsapDv:0000027.definition: Organogenesis stage during which upper limbs are longer and bent at elbow.
HsapDv:0000027.label: Carnegie stage 20

HsapDv:0000028.definition: Organogenesis stage during which hands and feet turned inward.
HsapDv:0000028.label: Carnegie stage 21

HsapDv:0000029.definition: Organogenesis stage during which eyelids and external ears appear.
HsapDv:0000029.label: Carnegie stage 22

HsapDv:0000030.definition: Organogenesis stage during which the head, the body, and the limbs are rounded structures.
HsapDv:0000030.label: Carnegie stage 23

HsapDv:0000031.definition: Carnegie developmental stage 5 defined by a solid trophoblast.
HsapDv:0000031.label: Carnegie stage 05a

HsapDv:0000032.definition: Carnegie developmental stage 5 defined by a trophoblastic lacunae.
HsapDv:0000032.label: Carnegie stage 05b

HsapDv:0000033.definition: Carnegie developmental stage 5 defined by a lacunar vascular circle.
HsapDv:0000033.label: Carnegie stage 05c

HsapDv:0000034.definition: Carnegie developmental stage 6 during which chorionic villi appear.
HsapDv:0000034.label: Carnegie stage 06a

HsapDv:0000035.definition: Carnegie developmental stage 6 during which the primitive streak appears.
HsapDv:0000035.label: Carnegie stage 06b
